title: Even powers of the probability norm
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability distribution on $\Omega$, let $r$ be a positive integer, and let $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. Define $\|f\|_{p,\pi}=\left(\sum_{x\in\Omega}\pi(x)|f(x)|^p\right)^{1/p}$. Then $\|f\|_{2r,\pi}^{2r}=\sum_{x\in\Omega}\pi(x)f(x)^{2r}$.
